tools.name: lookup_hexagram
tools.description: Return the full classical sources for a hexagram by its number (1–64): judgment (卦辞), image (大象), Tuan commentary, Zhu Xi 周易本义, Yang Tian Cai modern explanation, Yarrow's separately labelled Chinese reading aid, and historical anecdote — with available Chinese and English source material.

tools.name: lookup_yilin
tools.description: Look up the 焦氏易林 verse for a primary hexagram changing into another hexagram. This is a local classical-source lookup, not an AI reading.

tools.name: divine
tools.description: Ask the I Ching. See your next step. Cast a hexagram, show the classical sources first, then offer a thoughtful reflection grounded in those sources. Sources first. Reflection, not prediction. The divine name remains stable for oracle/divination client compatibility. Supports English, Chinese, Japan
